description: Create a new CDSS (Kafka) cluster (G2). Set returnClusterId=true to get the new cluster's serviceGroupInstanceNo back — the default operation returns only success/failure, so you would otherwise have to find the cluster with ncloud_cdss_list_clusters. Use dryRun=true to preview.

brokerNodeStorageSize.description: Broker storage in GB (100-2000, 10GB increment, SSD)

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, '-'; starts with a letter, ends with a letter or number, no consecutive '-')

configGroupNo.description: Config group number for the same Kafka version (from ncloud_cdss_list_config_groups). Required — if the account has no group for this version yet, create one first with ncloud_cdss_create_config_group

kafkaManagerUserName.description: CMAK access account ID (3-15 chars, same rule as clusterName; still required by the API — CMAK itself is being phased out by Ncloud)

kafkaManagerUserPassword.description: CMAK access account password: 8-20 chars mixing letters, numbers and special characters; must not contain ' " ` ₩ / & or spaces

returnClusterId.description: If true, calls the variant that returns the new cluster's serviceGroupInstanceNo

name: ncloud_cdss_create_cluster
